portraits.era_note: Observed reference date: 1992-12-31. Approved illustrative appearance interval 1991-01-01 to 1996-01-01 (exclusive), exactly as requested. No age gap: the photograph (31 December 1992) lies inside the requested window 1991-01-01 to 1996-01-01, about two years after its start and three years before its exclusive end. Fahd's birth year is given variously as about 1920 to 1923 in general biographical sources (not C01 research; leaders_1990.json leaves it null), so he is roughly 69 to 72 in the photograph and in his late sixties to mid seventies across the window; the prompt asks for one dignified appearance of a man of about seventy with no frailty. The 1 January 1996 delegation decree (C01-45 claim sa_fahd_delegation_19960101) is used only as the window's appearance boundary; reports of a late-1995 stroke are general knowledge and are not depicted. Artistic extensions declared in the prompt: the standing pose, the lower robe hem and the plain black low shoes (feet out of frame in a seated photograph). Small 600 x 410 scan; Fahd's face is only about 45 px wide, so the prompt asks for a simple, faithful face rather than invented detail. The live Commons 'source' link (bush41library.tamu.edu/audiovisual/photos/37) now redirects to the Library homepage, but its archived capture (20201017203816) lists the file as official White House photograph P38849-17, and the Library's archived file (20201025020135) is byte-identical to the Commons bytes. The individual White House photographer is not named. Date and place are also corroborated by the White House Digest of 31 December 1992. Art availability only: no new office boundary, tenure or historical acceptance. Small 600×410 source limits facial detail; standing pose, robe hem and shoes are declared extensions.
